_comment: RECORDED top-k retrieval output of a REGRESSED RAG system (the planted retrieval regression), k=3. Models a degraded retriever — e.g. after a chunking change or an embedding-model swap — that now pulls generically-similar but wrong chunks for many questions. Faithful generation on top of this would answer confidently from the wrong context. retrieval@3 collapses to ~0.5. The gate must catch this and fail.
